gallery.title: File:"Crossin' the Pipey" - an historic landmark - geograph.org.uk - 1104384.jpg
gallery.description: "Crossin' the Pipey" - an historic landmark This is the famous "pipey" over the canal by the Seatown.  Used as a test of bravery for children of the 50's and maybe earlier and an attraction for adventurous revellers this historic picture will touch a tender spot for those former Seatown dwellers in distant parts.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A fisher cottage of Seatown - geograph.org.uk - 1159337.jpg
gallery.title: File:A fisher cottage of Seatown - geograph.org.uk - 1159337.jpg
gallery.description: A fisher cottage of Seatown A unique assembly of cottages is found here. If you follow the lane you can see the jaws of the Seatown footbridge.  In the early days, outsiders would not cross this unless they had legitimate business in Seatown.

gallery.filename: A view from the Seatown footbridge - geograph.org.uk - 1159333.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view from the Seatown footbridge - geograph.org.uk - 1159333.jpg
gallery.description: A view from the Seatown footbridge Once the site of the fishing community, the Seatown had its own rules. Woe betide anyone in the early days who ventured across the bridge and into these parts!
